page.overview:
Who is Araval?

Araval was the thirteenth King of Arthedain.

He was the son of Arveleg II and was born into a time of war and strife. At the time of his birth, his father's realm of Arthedain had been under threat from the evil eastern land of Angmar for more than four hundred years.

Araval, too, played his part in the war with Angmar. Little is said of his career, but it was hinted that he was a diplomat and a warrior. In alliance with the Elves of Lindon and Rivendell, he won at least one important victory over the Witch-king of Angmar. We are also told that he attempted the recolonization of Cardolan, though this was prevented by the evil beings, the wights, sent there by the Witch-king some two centuries before.

In the end, though, Araval's bravery counted for little. His grandson Arvedui, who was born in Araval's lifetime and just thirteen years after his great victory, was to see the final destruction of the kingdom of Arthedain.
